description: Give us the address of a paid API endpoint (one that answers with HTTP 402), a remote MCP server or an A2A agent card that we don't list yet. No key needed. We check it like a service from a registry: one unpaid request per scheduled interval, never a paid call, no tool called. It joins the directory if its checks meet our listing criteria. We keep only the address; returns the service id and page.

kind.description: paid_api, mcp_server or a2a_agent. Left out: worked out from the address.

method.description: For a paid_api called with POST (we send no body). Default GET.

name: submit_service
title: Submit a service
